gap: Existing estimate panel had no path from the displayed source-bound estimate to a confirmed preparation WorkJob. New code reuses existing composition create/run/readback and Pending, without shared store/schema edits.

contract.purpose: Bind an explicitly selected saved-source revision and estimate comparison conditions into a zero-budget preparation WorkJob through existing workflow APIs.
contract.experience: Estimate with explicit currency/comparison cap; separate materials+conditions checkbox; create preparation work. Creation saves only plan with source=null. Separate existing saveMaterial consent and compose-check run stores the reference descriptor, not original text. The original job remains unchanged.
contract.responsibility: ROCK validates client intent, fresh same-owner GET projection and existing workflow payload/readback. OWNER explicitly chooses material version and cap for preparation. Existing server session/owner scope header remains authentication authority. EXTERNAL pricing/real paid generation is not enabled.
contract.inputOutput: Canonical eve.text-handoff/1 contains ownerScope, original jobId/revision/ordered material hashes/promptDigest, normalized model/currency/rate/card/expiry/ceiling, explicit preparation cap and two consents, preparationOnly=true/executionAuthorized=false, SHA256 binding. Plan is a single compose-check, budgetMinor=0, existing USD/JPY currencies. No manuscripts are copied.
contract.states: Existing active -> local checker -> review -> explicit complete. Existing Pending(owner, jobId, creation fingerprint or commandId) handles uncertain create/run. Unknown original operation is retained. No new job engine or billing ledger.
contract.storage: Existing owner-bound work store, existing create/run GET attachment APIs, revision/fingerprint CAS unchanged. In-memory transfer draft is unsaved until separate saveMaterial run; closing the tab before that loses the unsaved descriptor. Restoring committed artifact is GET-only.
contract.failures: Before a new write, authenticate list owner and re-read exact original job; changed owner/source/revision/expired or altered comparison/cap/plan refuses. Auth loss preserves Pending. A source GET404 after an attempted child write cannot prove child rejection and retains unknown state. Quote expiry scheduling re-arms on preparation consent changes; repeated identical checkbox events do not invalidate the active timer. Deadline callback must request its own state update without a forced render.
contract.recovery: Known child GET with matching fingerprint reconciles after expiry without another POST. If child is not yet readable and original is missing or conditions expire, retain exact Pending and avoid new POST. Never-sent definitive invalidity can clear Pending so the user can return to the original and re-estimate.
contract.approval: Checkbox approves only the displayed preparation snapshot. It is not a signed quote, reservation, debit, provider permission or budget grant. The browser ownerScope is an intent token, not an authentication credential. Existing server API performs actual same-user authentication.
contract.acceptance: Exact2/3/4 source bindings, explicit cap/consents, owner/revision and final-await expiry negatives, stale callback/duplicate click refusal, original preservation, existing create/run/restore GET-only, unknown404 retention then same-ID reconciliation, zero paid endpoints/provider requests.
contract.undecided: Existing API has no cross-job atomic source/rate authorization. The preflight GET-to-write interval is not an execution fence. A zero-budget preparation may record an earlier snapshot; any future paid effect needs fresh server source/service/rate verification, authoritative approval, atomic budget/claim and usage reconciliation. Real browser, actual authenticated storage, Provider, finance/device/public and whole EVE remain separate.
